taxnestc@eu1 ~]$ cd ~/public_html

echo "===== Real login test with CORRECT field name 'login' ====="
read -p "Admin login (email/phone/CNIC/NTN): " CRED
read -sp "Password: " PASS
echo

rm -f /tmp/jar.txt
curl -s -c /tmp/jar.txt https://taxnest.com.pk/login -o /tmp/login_get.html
TOKEN=$(grep -oP 'name="_token"[^>]*value="\K[^"]+' /tmp/login_get.html | head -1)
echo "CSRF: ${TOKEN:0:25}..."
echo

echo "POST response headers:"
curl -s -i -b /tmp/jar.txt -c /tmp/jar.txt \
  -X POST "https://taxnest.com.pk/login" \
  --data-urlencode "_token=$TOKEN" \
  --data-urlencode "login=$CRED" \
  --data-urlencode "password=$PASS" 2>&1 | grep -iE "^HTTP|^Location:|^Set-Cookie:" | head -10

echo
echo "Sessions table after attempt:"
history -d $(history 1) passwordord, 1, 4) AS pw_prefix FROM admin_users WHERE e
